result.one_liner: Team communication platform with channels, messaging, and workspace integrations

evidence.quote: To obtain users' tokens, you need to send users through the OAuth 2.0 authentication flow
Tokens are presented with the string Bearer prepended to them, indicating the OAuth 2.0 authentication scheme
The Slack API is free, and rate limits are tier-based (1-100+ requests per minute) depending on method
You can join the Developer Program and provision a sandbox with access to all Slack features for free
Slack has run its own remote MCP server at mcp.slack.com/mcp since February 17, 2026

result.notes: Slack provides free, self-serve API access with OAuth2 authentication. Official MCP server available since Feb 2026. Web API (REST) includes 150+ methods. No approval or paid subscription required for API access.
